caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair viewed from the side, with its rockers curved and positioned diagonally, occupying most of the scene. The frame of the chair is composed of dark brown wood with turned spindle detailing on the arms, legs, and backrest support structures. The chair features a padded seat and a padded backrest, both upholstered in a light blue-green fabric with subtle shading indicating texture. There is an additional rectangular cushion or padded area attached to the upper backrest, also covered in a matching blue-green patterned material and fastened with visible buttons at the top corners. The structural joints and spindles of the chair are accented with golden brown highlights, emphasizing the roundness and ornate craftsmanship of the woodworking. The drawing is bordered by a thin rectangular line near the edge of the pale, neutral background. The artist's signature, "Florence Tyzack," appears near the bottom left of the composition.
title: Chair with Head Rests
